## 4. CrabLink Phase 2 Round 1 Interpretation

For CrabLink, Phase 2 Round 1 means:

```text
CrabLink may display backend-derived verifier/replay/readiness status,
but the client must not construct, verify, finalize, or economically trust it as authority.
```

Good client behavior:

```text
display read-only replay/verifier status from backend/gateway/omnigate
label status honestly
show diagnostic/readiness/proof-view context
keep paid unlock tied to backend wallet/ledger receipt truth
keep receipts display-only
keep balances backend-derived
keep cache convenience-only
verify b3 before trusted render
avoid secrets in React state/localStorage/URL/logs
keep Tauri Rust as native privilege boundary
keep TS adapters typed/redacted
```

Bad client behavior:

```text
client constructs QuickChain roots
client constructs checkpoint hashes
client verifies finality as authority
client creates verifier truth
client creates quorum truth
client creates fork choice
client unlocks paid content from replay artifact alone
client unlocks paid content from proof artifact alone
client unlocks paid content from cache alone
client invents receipt
client invents balance
client silently spends
client stores secrets in React/localStorage/URL/logs
client treats crab:// or b3 as economic authority
client treats index/policy/gateway/omnigate metadata as settlement truth
```

---

## 5. Critical Paid Access Boundary

The paid flow must remain:

```text
prepare / quote
→ explicit user confirmation
→ backend wallet path
→ backend ledger receipt
→ unlock/render
→ display-only receipt cache
→ balance refresh
```

For Phase 2 Round 1, add this rule:

```text
read-only replay/proof/verifier artifacts may decorate or explain access status,
but they must not replace backend wallet/ledger receipt truth.
```

CrabLink can show:

```text
accepted
epoch_included
finalized
anchored
replay_available
replay_mismatch
verifier_view_available
diagnostic_only
```

But CrabLink must label and consume these honestly:

```text
accepted backend receipt may unlock paid content
epoch_included/finalized/anchored are status labels only unless backend policy says otherwise
replay_available is diagnostic/read-only
replay_mismatch must not create local truth
verifier_view_available is not client authority
proof artifact presence is not paid unlock
```

### What Changed in `ron-proto`

`ron-proto` added bounded Phase 2 committee/readiness DTO vocabulary:

```text
QuickChainCommitteeMemberV1
QuickChainVerifierAttestationV1
QuickChainCommitteeAttestationSetV1
QuickChainCommitteeReadinessResultV1
QuickChainCommitteeReadinessStatusV1
QuickChainCommitteeDisagreementCodeV1
```

Schema/vocabulary additions included:

```text
quickchain.committee-member.v1
quickchain.verifier-attestation.v1
quickchain.committee-attestation-set.v1
quickchain.committee-readiness-result.v1
quickchain.verifier-attestation-payload.v1
bounded_committee_replay_attestation_v1
```

The DTO layer now validates:

```text
schema/version correctness
chain_id and epoch_id consistency
bounded committee member count
bounded attestation count
required_attestations > 0
required_attestations <= committee size
unique committee member IDs
attestation member must be declared
one attestation per committee member
attestation replay_result_hash must match set replay_result_hash
attestation replay_status must match set replay_status
readiness status/count consistency
strict unknown-field rejection
```

This did not add:

```text
signature cryptographic verification
live committee selection
public validator runtime
finality
settlement
staking/slashing
public bridge
external chain authority
wallet mutation
ledger mutation
```

### What Changed in `ron-ledger`

`ron-ledger` added a read-only committee readiness evaluator:

```text
evaluate_committee_readiness_from_attestations
```

This evaluates a validated `QuickChainCommitteeAttestationSetV1` and returns a `QuickChainCommitteeReadinessResultV1`.

It returns:

```text
Ready
```

only when:

```text
accepted_attestations_count >= required_attestations
```

It returns:

```text
NotReady + InsufficientAttestations
```

when:

```text
accepted_attestations_count < required_attestations
```

It rejects invalid attestation sets before readiness evaluation.

It does not:

```text
mutate ledger state
mutate wallet state
issue ROC
transfer ROC
burn ROC
open/capture/release/expire holds
create receipts
verify signatures cryptographically
decide finality
choose forks
start validators
create public chain state
anchor externally
settle externally
prune data
create staking/slashing rules
```

Good framing:

```text
svc-rewarder + svc-storage are being made committee-ready from the boundary side.
They can provide or store deterministic artifacts that future verifiers may inspect.
They must not produce committee attestations, quorum certificates, fork choice, finality, or settlement outcomes.
```

```text
rewarder signs committee attestations
storage verifies finality
storage unlocks paid content from committee claims
rewarder executes payout because committee agreed
storage becomes DA/pruning authority
rewarder becomes validator reward executor
```

Correct separation:

```text
future committee / verifier layer verifies artifacts
svc-rewarder produces planning artifacts only
svc-storage stores/verifies bytes only
svc-wallet executes approved mutations only
ron-ledger records durable truth only
```

## QuickChain doctrine to preserve

QuickChain remains future settlement infrastructure.

The active doctrine is:

```text
determinism before distribution
DTOs before roots
roots before validators
proofs before pruning
internal ROC before external anchors
```

Current Phase 2 is still not:

```text
- public validator economy
- staking
- slashing
- liquidity
- exchange-facing logic
- public bridge
- ROX runtime
- Solana runtime
- external settlement
- external L2/DA active runtime
```

CrabLink must remain a client/product layer only.

---

## CrabLink authority boundary

CrabLink Tauri is the primary client.

Tauri Rust mediates native privilege.

React owns display and user intent only.

TypeScript owns no backend truth.

CrabLink may:

```text
- display backend-derived wallet/receipt/status information
- request paid prepare/quote flows
- ask the user for explicit confirmation before paid actions
- call typed TS adapters
- call allowlisted Tauri commands
- call configured svc-gateway
- display backend-derived replay/verifier/committee-readiness labels
- verify b3 cache before trusted render
- keep display-only receipt/status cache
- show honest status labels
```

CrabLink must not:

```text
- mutate ron-ledger
- bypass svc-wallet
- invent balances
- invent receipts
- invent paid unlocks
- unlock paid content from cache alone
- treat localStorage/cache as entitlement truth
- create QuickChain roots
- create checkpoint hashes
- create signed verification attestations
- decide verifier result truth
- decide committee membership
- decide quorum
- decide fork choice
- decide finality
- decide settlement
- anchor externally
- bridge externally
- implement staking/slashing/liquidity
- act as validator or settlement runtime
```

---

## Important product boundary

Paid flow remains:

```text
prepare/quote
→ explicit confirmation
→ backend wallet path
→ backend receipt
→ unlock/render
→ display-only receipt cache
→ balance refresh
```

CrabLink must not shortcut this with:

```text
cache-only unlock
client-only paid proof
policy-only unlock
index pointer unlock
committee label unlock
quorum label unlock
finality label unlock
local receipt fabrication
fake balance
silent spend
```

Accepted backend receipt remains enough for current paid unlock.

Future statuses such as:

```text
accepted
epoch_included
finalized
anchored
verifier_ready
committee_ready
quorum_ready
```

must be displayed honestly and never treated as client-side authority.

## 6. Phase 3 Round 1 Starting Scope — `ron-proto + ron-ledger`

The next session starts with:

```text
ron-proto + ron-ledger
```

### Why this pair is first

This pair comes first because:

```text
ron-proto defines DTOs and schema boundaries.
ron-ledger owns deterministic economic truth and replay boundaries.
Phase 3 validator identity must first be expressed without granting balance authority.
```

The correct starting posture is:

```text
DTOs before validator authority.
Identity shape before validator lifecycle.
Capability shape before admission enforcement.
Read-only validation before any runtime signing path.
No economics.
No staking.
No slashing.
```

## 7. Expected `ron-proto` Phase 3 Round 1 Work

`ron-proto` may add strict DTO shapes for passport-gated validator identity and capability boundaries.

Likely safe DTO concepts:

```text
QuickChainValidatorIdentityV1
QuickChainValidatorSetV1
QuickChainValidatorSetMemberV1
QuickChainValidatorCapabilityV1
QuickChainValidatorAdmissionV1
QuickChainValidatorRevocationV1
QuickChainValidatorEligibilityV1
QuickChainValidatorSetHashInputV1
QuickChainAttestationIdentityV1
```

Naming can differ after code inspection, but keep names clear and versioned.

Required semantics:

```text
schema/version field required
deny unknown fields
chain_id required
epoch_id or validator_set_version required where relevant
validator_member_id required
passport_subject or passport_id required
capability_id required if capability-gated
registry_entry_id optional only if explicitly staged
policy_hash required when policy-bound
validator_set_hash input must be deterministic
member list must be sorted/canonical
duplicate validator identities reject
duplicate passport subjects reject
duplicate capability IDs reject where relevant
revoked validators reject in validatorset validation
expired capabilities reject in validation helpers if expiry is supplied
```

Safe validation helpers may include:

```text
validate_validator_identity_v1
validate_validator_capability_v1
validate_validator_set_v1
validate_attestation_identity_v1
canonical_validator_member_sort_key
canonical_validator_set_hash_payload
```

Allowed `ron-proto` scope:

```text
strict DTOs
schema constants
validation helpers
sort-key helpers
canonical hash payload builders
unknown-field rejection tests
duplicate rejection tests
revoked/expired identity rejection tests
passport/capability shape tests
validator-set hash input shape tests
```

Forbidden `ron-proto` scope:

```text
no actual private-key signing
no real cryptographic signature verification unless it is clearly DTO-only and already supported
no KMS integration
no registry network calls
no passport service calls
no live validator selection
no quorum finality
no settlement
no wallet mutation
no ledger mutation
no staking
no slashing
no bond DTOs yet unless explicitly deferred/disabled as Phase 4-only
no public bridge
no ROX/Solana active runtime
```

---

## 8. Expected `ron-ledger` Phase 3 Round 1 Work

`ron-ledger` should remain economic truth and deterministic replay core.

For Phase 3 Round 1, it may add **read-only validator-set gating checks** around already-existing committee/readiness/attestation evaluation.

Possible safe ledger-side functions:

```text
validate_attestation_identity_against_validator_set
evaluate_passport_gated_attestation_set
reject_unauthorized_validator_attestation
reject_revoked_validator_attestation
reject_expired_validator_capability
validate_validator_set_hash_binding
```

Naming can change after code inspection.

Expected behavior:

```text
valid passport/registry-gated validator identity can be accepted for readiness evaluation
unauthorized identity rejects
revoked validator rejects
expired validator capability rejects
attestation from undeclared validator rejects
attestation from validator outside active validator set rejects
duplicate validator attestations reject
validator set hash mismatch rejects
chain_id/epoch_id mismatch rejects
```

Allowed `ron-ledger` scope:

```text
read-only validator-set membership checks
read-only attestation identity checks
read-only capability expiry/revocation checks
deterministic error taxonomy
tests proving validators cannot mutate balances
tests proving no staking/slashing hooks exist
tests proving user balances are unaffected by validator readiness
tests proving invalid identities do not count toward readiness
```

Forbidden `ron-ledger` scope:

```text
no validator balance authority
no validator mutation of user balances
no validator-triggered issue/transfer/burn/hold/capture/release
no staking
no slashing
no bond lifecycle
no validator rewards
no validator public market
no finality claims
no external settlement
no public bridge
no ROX/Solana active runtime
no pruning
no DA/archive dependency
```


## 21. Risks to Watch in Phase 3

### Risk 1 — Validator identity becomes balance authority

Mitigation:

```text
ron-ledger tests must prove validator identity/readiness cannot mutate balances.
svc-wallet remains the only mutation front-door.
```

### Risk 2 — Passport/registry lookup becomes consensus truth

Mitigation:

```text
Registry/passport data may gate membership, but deterministic validator-set material must be canonical and hash-bound for replay.
```

### Risk 3 — CrabLink starts signing or verifying as authority

Mitigation:

```text
CrabLink remains display-only. No client attestation signing. No client finality.
```

### Risk 4 — Phase 4 economics sneak into Phase 3

Mitigation:

```text
No staking, no slashing, no bonds, no validator reward market in Phase 3.
```

### Risk 5 — Public validator network language creeps in

Mitigation:

```text
Use “passport-gated validator set” and “known/gated validators,” not “public validator economy.”
```

### Risk 6 — Service calls enter deterministic root/replay logic

Mitigation:

```text
Root/replay/attestation validation must use canonical exported artifacts, not live network calls or service-local mutable state.
```

## CrabLink boundaries to enforce

### React boundary

React may:

```text
display backend-derived status
request quotes
request explicit user confirmation
call TS adapters
show receipts returned by backend
show validator/readiness labels if backend-derived
show cache verification status
```

React must not:

```text
hold private keys
hold raw capabilities
hold uncapped spend authority
invent balances
invent receipts
invent paid unlocks
invent validator status
invent finality
invent settlement
construct validator attestations
sign checkpoints
interpret cache as paid entitlement
call raw Tauri invoke directly where adapters should be used
```

### TypeScript adapter boundary

TS adapters may:

```text
wrap typed requests
normalize display inputs
call allowlisted Tauri commands
call gateway routes
handle display-only receipts/status
```

TS adapters must not:

```text
send validator authority claims
send passport registry authority claims
send validator capability authority claims
send validator-set authority claims
send settlement/finality authority claims
send fake receipt/balance/unlock claims
hold secrets
persist spend authority
persist private keys
bypass explicit paid confirmation
```

### Tauri Rust command boundary

Tauri commands must be:

```text
small
typed
allowlisted
redacted
bounded
source-labeled
policy-aware
feature-gated
testable
```

Forbidden command patterns:

```text
run
execute
eval
shell
native
raw_*
sign_checkpoint
produce_root
produce_checkpoint
admit_validator
revoke_validator
rotate_validator
grant_validator_capability
unlock_from_validator_passport
unlock_from_validator_set
```

Tauri outputs must not include:

```text
secrets
raw errors
stack traces
private keys
tokens
capabilities
spend authority
validator authority
wallet mutation authority
ledger mutation authority
```

### Offline cache boundary

Offline cache may:

```text
store display convenience data
verify b3 before trusted render
remember backend-derived receipts as display-only history
remember backend-derived validator/readiness status as display-only status if implemented
```

Offline cache must not:

```text
unlock paid content alone
produce paid receipt truth
produce balance truth
produce validator truth
produce finality truth
produce settlement truth
replace backend refresh
```

## 6. Test-only fix applied during this session

Initial `svc-storage` test failure:

```text
error[E0597]: `top_level` does not live long enough
error[E0597]: `nested` does not live long enough
```

Cause:

```text
AccountingExportRequest and UsageEventDto contain &'static str fields.
The test dynamically built JSON Strings and tried to deserialize them into DTOs requiring static string fields.
```

Fix:

```text
Converted the dynamic test JSON strings into leaked static test fixtures using:
Box::leak(...into_boxed_str())
```

This was test-only.

It did not change production runtime behavior.

It did not weaken DTO rejection.

It did not change DTO schema.

Also fixed in `svc-rewarder` test:

```text
Removed unused RewardFundingSource import so clippy -D warnings stays green.
```

## 3. Blueprint review — what the passport/registry/auth expectation means

The blueprint’s validator trust model says future high-trust validator eligibility should involve:

```text
main RON Passport
reputation threshold
uptime history
registered validator identity
capability token
governance admission during beta
future ROC bond only if bonding exists
future slashing policy only if slashing exists
```

That does not mean CrabLink should implement validator admission.

That does not mean React should validate passports.

That does not mean Tauri should become validator registry authority.

That does not mean the client should sign validator membership.

Correct interpretation for this phase:

```text
Backend-derived validator/passport/lifecycle/readiness context may be displayed.
The client may show status.
The client may route user intent.
The client may call typed/allowlisted gateway-backed adapters.
The client must not decide validator membership, lifecycle, governance, finality, settlement, paid access, balances, or receipts.
```

CrabLink’s job is display/user intent only.

Backend truth remains backend truth.

## 10. Passport / registry / auth boundary for CrabLink

CrabLink may display backend-derived references such as:

```text
validator readiness status
validator/passport display label
validator capability display metadata
registry-derived readiness state
revocation/readiness display state
downtime/degraded display state
lifecycle review state
governance review state
```

But these must be treated as:

```text
display metadata
backend-derived context
read-only status
non-authoritative UI state
```

CrabLink must not locally decide:

```text
passport is valid for validator role
passport is revoked
validator is admitted
validator is rotated
validator is revoked
validator is down
validator is degraded
validator equivocated
replay challenge is accepted
governance parameter update is approved
validator set changed
```

If the UI needs these facts later, it should receive them from backend service truth through configured gateway/omnigate paths.

No direct client-side registry authority.

No hidden local validator admission policy.

No local passport capability parser that grants authority.

---

Paid content unlock rule remains:

```text
accepted backend wallet/ledger receipt is enough for normal paid unlock
```

CrabLink must not unlock from:

```text
cache alone
b3 hash alone
crab:// URL alone
index pointer alone
policy allow decision alone
validator readiness alone
validator lifecycle evidence alone
replay challenge evidence alone
governance approval metadata alone
receipt-looking local object alone
Tauri localStorage/sessionStorage state alone
```

Correct paid flow remains:

```text
prepare/quote
→ explicit user confirmation
→ backend wallet path
→ backend receipt
→ unlock/render
→ display-only receipt cache
→ balance refresh
```

No fake ROC.

No silent spend.

No local spend authority.

## 12. Offline cache boundary

Offline cache may:

```text
store convenience data
verify b3 before trusted render
display cached metadata honestly
support offline read of already-authorized free or previously available data where safe
```

Offline cache must not:

```text
unlock paid content alone
invent receipt truth
invent balance truth
invent validator truth
invent finality
invent settlement
turn b3 verification into paid authorization
turn cached lifecycle/evidence metadata into authority
```

Expected client test theme:

```text
offline cache verifies bytes, not entitlement.
```

```text
bridges

fake balances

silent spend
```

```text

DTOs before roots
roots before validators
proofs before pruning
internal ROC before external anchors
```

## 8. Tauri bridge rules to preserve

Tauri Rust may mediate native privilege, but it must remain bounded and non-authoritative.

Allowed:

```text
small typed commands
allowlisted commands
bounded payloads
redacted errors
gateway-first network calls
b3 verification
supervised optional sidecar handling
display-only local cache
```

Forbidden:

```text
raw invoke authority
run / execute / eval / shell commands
unbounded filesystem or network authority
secrets returned to React
private keys returned to React
raw capabilities returned to React
spend authority returned to React
wallet mutation commands created for QuickChain Phase 4
ledger mutation commands created for QuickChain Phase 4
bond/slash/stake/liquidity commands created client-side
```

Command names should not include authority-shaped verbs such as:

```text
commit_bond
capture_validator_bond
release_validator_bond
slash_validator
execute_slashing
open_staking_market
create_liquidity_pool
bridge_settlement
finalize_settlement
mint_rox
solana_settle
```

---

## 9. React / TypeScript rules to preserve

React may:

```text
display backend-derived status
display backend-derived receipt metadata
ask for user confirmation
route user intent through typed adapters
show paid-access warnings
show offline/cache limitations
```

React must not:

```text
hold secrets
hold private keys
hold raw capabilities
hold spend authority
hold wallet truth
hold ledger truth
hold bond truth
hold slash truth
hold settlement truth
invent receipts
invent balances
invent paid unlocks
silently spend ROC
treat cache as entitlement authority
```

TypeScript adapters may:

```text
normalize request shapes
call safe Tauri commands
call configured gateway paths
redact logs
label source of data
keep display-only DTOs separate from authority DTOs
```

TypeScript adapters must not:

```text
bypass Tauri policy
call raw invoke directly from React components
construct ledger operations
construct wallet mutation authority
construct bond/slash/stake/liquidity authority
treat idempotency keys as authority
treat operation IDs as client-created authority
```

---

## 10. Paid flow rules to preserve

The paid flow must remain:

```text
prepare / quote
explicit confirmation
backend wallet path
backend receipt
unlock / render
display-only receipt cache
balance refresh
```

Forbidden paid flow regressions:

```text
fake receipt
fake balance
fake finality
silent spend
cache-only paid unlock
client-only entitlement
localStorage unlock authority
IndexedDB unlock authority
offline cache unlock authority
policy/index/client allow decision treated as receipt truth
```

For Phase 4 Round 1, bond/readiness/slash-simulation display must not alter paid-flow authority.

---

## 11. Offline cache rules to preserve

Offline cache may:

```text
cache bytes
verify b3 before trusted render
improve UX
display stale/offline indicators
store display-only receipt copies
```

Offline cache must not:

```text
unlock paid content alone
create paid entitlement truth
create receipt truth
create balance truth
create finality truth
create bond truth
create slash truth
create validator truth
```

Safe language:

```text
cache is convenience only
b3 verifies bytes only
backend receipt is required for paid unlock
backend wallet/ledger remains truth
```

---

## 12. Sidecar / local node rules to preserve

A sidecar or local node may be present only if it remains:

```text
optional
explicit
supervised
bounded
disabled by default
not a wallet authority
not ledger truth
not QuickChain authority
not validator authority
not bond/slash authority
not bridge/settlement authority
```

Forbidden:

```text
background chain authority
local validator authority
local settlement authority
local wallet mutation truth
local receipt truth
local slashing authority
automatic sidecar spending
```

## 5. Non-negotiable doctrine to preserve

Active QuickChain doctrine:

```text
determinism before distribution
DTOs before roots
roots before validators
proofs before pruning
internal ROC before external anchors
```

Internal value loop remains:

```text
ron-proto economic DTOs
→ ron-ledger durable economic truth
→ svc-wallet issue/transfer/burn/hold/capture/release/receipt
→ svc-storage/svc-gateway/omnigate paid enforcement
→ ron-accounting snapshots
→ svc-rewarder payout planning
→ wallet/ledger receipts
→ CrabLink display-only receipt/cache/user intent
```

Service boundaries remain:

```text
svc-wallet:
  mutation front-door

ron-ledger:
  economic truth

ron-accounting:
  snapshots/reports only, not balance truth

svc-rewarder:
  payout planning only, never ledger mutation

svc-storage:
  bytes/artifacts by b3 only, not payment truth

svc-gateway:
  public boundary/enforcement/proxy surface only, not wallet/ledger/slash truth

omnigate:
  hydration/product coordinator only, not durable economic truth

svc-index:
  lookup/pointer only

ron-policy:
  declarative policy only

CrabLink Tauri:
  display/user intent only
```

```text
- gateway must not expose slash/dispute execution routes
- gateway must not expose irreversible slash/capture/burn/forfeiture routes
- gateway must not mutate wallet state
- gateway must not mutate ledger state
- gateway must not create receipts
```

```text
- omnigate must not turn policy/index/cache/evidence labels into entitlement truth
- omnigate must not expose staking, liquidity, bridge, ROX/Solana, or external settlement behavior
```

Expected Phase 4 CrabLink focus:
CrabLink must remain display/user-intent only.
CrabLink must not become chain authority, validator authority, bond authority, reserve-slash authority, capture/release authority, wallet authority, ledger authority, or paid unlock authority.

CrabLink may display backend-derived Phase 4 bond status, dispute status, enforcement status, and validator/operator status as labeled UI metadata only.

CrabLink must not:

* construct bond enforcement truth locally
* execute bond enforcement
* reserve slash material
* release slash reserves
* capture slash reserves
* perform controlled slash
* create validator consequences
* create finality
* create settlement truth
* create paid unlock truth
* create fake receipts
* create fake balances
* use cache-only unlocks
* use client headers or localStorage as authority
* expose raw Tauri invoke commands that imply wallet/ledger/bond enforcement authority
* store secrets, spend authority, capabilities, or receipts as client truth
* introduce Solana, ROX, external settlement, bridge, staking, liquidity, or exchange-facing runtime code

Architecture rules for the CrabLink patch:

* Tauri Rust mediates native privilege.
* React owns display and user intent, not authority.
* TypeScript owns no secrets and no backend truth.
* React must call typed adapters, not raw invoke directly.
* Commands must be small, typed, allowlisted, bounded, redacted, feature-gated, and policy-aware.
* Any Phase 4 bond/enforcement UI must be display-only.
* Any paid unlock must still require backend wallet/ledger receipt truth.
* Offline cache can verify b3 before render but cannot unlock paid content alone.
* Passport is identity/capability, not wallet.
* Wallet remains economic authority through backend wallet path.
* Ledger remains durable truth.
* crab:// navigation is not authority.
* b3 hash is content identity, not paid access authority.

Expected CrabLink Phase 4 Round 3 test themes:

1. Client boundary check:

   * No client chain authority.
   * No validator/bond/slash authority in React/TS/Tauri command surfaces.
   * No raw invoke names like execute_bond_enforcement, reserve_slash, capture_slash_reserve, release_slash_reserve, slash_validator, bridge_settlement, mint_rox, solana_settlement, open_staking_market, create_liquidity_pool.

2. Paid/cache boundary check:

   * No unlock from bond enforcement metadata.
   * No unlock from slash reserve metadata.
   * No unlock from index pointer metadata.
   * No unlock from policy allow/deny.
   * No unlock from cache alone.
   * No unlock from localStorage/sessionStorage alone.
   * No fake receipt or fake balance generation.

3. Tauri command boundary check:

   * No command names that imply native wallet/ledger/bond enforcement authority.
   * No command outputs containing spend authority, secret capability, private key, seed, raw capability, fake receipt, fake balance, validator authority, slash authority, settlement authority, bridge authority.
   * No raw shell/eval/execute/run commands.
   * No backend truth invented in TS or React state.

4. UI/status honesty check:

   * Allowed status labels are display-only and source-labeled.
   * If displayed, bond/enforcement/dispute status must be backend-derived.
   * UI must not label something as finalized/settled/anchored unless backend truth explicitly supplies it.
   * No Phase 4 public staking or liquidity claims.

5. Feature-gate check:

   * Any future sidecar/local node/validator/bond UI must be disabled or inert unless explicitly feature-gated.
   * Facets remain inert until sandboxed.
   * No mobile/localhost assumption for normal users.

## 16. Anchor-only doctrine

Phase 5 Round 1 anchor-only doctrine:

```text
An anchor proves that a compact commitment existed.
An anchor does not prove ROC balance truth by itself.
An anchor does not mutate wallet balances.
An anchor does not authorize paid unlock.
An anchor does not replace ron-ledger.
An anchor does not replace svc-wallet.
An anchor does not bypass policy.
An anchor does not bypass challenge windows.
An anchor does not make external settlement live.
An anchor does not create a bridge.
```

Correct anchor data flow:

```text
ron-ledger / QuickChain checkpoint material
→ compact canonical anchor payload
→ dry-run artifact
→ verifier checks payload/hash/commitment relation
→ optional future external timestamp/commitment proof
→ display as anchored evidence only
```

Incorrect anchor data flow:

```text
external chain event
→ mutate ROC balance

external chain event
→ unlock paid content

external chain event
→ replace wallet receipt

external chain event
→ replace ron-ledger state

external chain event
→ bridge mint/burn

external chain event
→ public settlement truth
```

---

## 17. Phase 5 Round 1 `ron-proto` expectations

`ron-proto` remains DTO-only.

It may define strict DTOs for anchor-only dry-run material if safe.

It must not:

```text
open sockets
call external chains
call Solana
call bridge relayers
mutate ledger state
produce live roots unless already authorized by prior phases and vectors
create validators
create settlement
create public chain state
create paid unlock truth
store secrets
hold private keys
```

Possible `ron-proto` DTO concepts:

```text
QuickChainAnchorCommitmentV1
QuickChainAnchorPayloadV1
QuickChainAnchorDryRunArtifactV1
QuickChainAnchorVerificationReportV1
QuickChainAnchorKind
QuickChainAnchorStatus
```

Possible enum values should stay conservative:

```text
anchor_only
dry_run
external_da_candidate
external_l2_candidate
hybrid_candidate
```

But for Round 1, prefer:

```text
anchor_only
dry_run
```

Avoid implying active integration.

Fields should be references, not authority:

```text
schema
chain_id
epoch_id
checkpoint_hash
state_root
receipt_root
accounting_snapshot_root
reward_manifest_root
policy_hash
chain_params_hash
validator_set_hash
anchor_payload_hash
created_at_epoch
anchor_kind
status
notes
```

Money fields, if any are unavoidable, must be integer minor-unit strings only. But Round 1 should avoid money fields unless explicitly necessary.

All hashes must be:

```text
b3:<64 lowercase hex>
```

Unknown fields must be rejected.

No floats.

No placeholder hashes.

No fake hashes.

No non-lowercase b3 hashes.

No raw Solana transaction fields unless explicitly deferred and inert.

## 18. Phase 5 Round 1 `ron-ledger` expectations

`ron-ledger` remains durable economic truth.

It may export dry-run anchor commitment material derived from already-approved deterministic checkpoint/root material.

It must not treat anchors as state inputs.

It must not mutate balances from anchor verification.

It must not alter receipt acceptance from anchor verification.

It must not unlock paid content from anchor verification.

It must not accept external chain data as economic truth.

It must not add a bridge.

It must not add public settlement.

Safe `ron-ledger` test goals:

```text
anchor payload derived from deterministic checkpoint material
same checkpoint material produces same anchor payload hash
anchor verifier accepts matching commitment payload
anchor verifier rejects malformed b3 hashes
anchor verifier rejects unknown fields
anchor verifier cannot mutate account balance
anchor verifier cannot mutate receipt status
anchor verifier cannot bypass wallet/ledger truth
anchor verifier cannot create paid unlock status
anchor verifier cannot replace internal finalized status
anchor verification is read-only
```

Forbidden `ron-ledger` implementation goals:

```text
external chain listener
bridge mint/burn
external settlement route
Solana RPC client
ROX token mapping
liquidity pool
exchange integration
staking market
anchor-driven balance mutation
anchor-driven receipt mutation
anchor-driven unlock
```

## 24. Non-negotiable QuickChain doctrine to preserve

The core doctrine remains:

```text
determinism before distribution
DTOs before roots
roots before validators
proofs before pruning
internal ROC before external anchors
```

QuickChain remains future ROC settlement infrastructure.

The active ROC authority model remains:

```text
svc-wallet = economic mutation front-door
ron-ledger = durable economic truth
ron-accounting = snapshots/reports, not balance truth
svc-rewarder = payout planning, not mutation
svc-storage = bytes/artifacts/manifests by b3, not payment truth
svc-gateway = public route/admission boundary, not ledger mutation
omnigate = hydration/access composition, not ledger mutation
svc-index = lookup/pointer only
ron-policy = declarative policy only
CrabLink Tauri = display/user intent/native mediation only
React/client adapters = display/user intent only
```

Phase 5 must not weaken these.

---

## 25. Internal ROC value loop still controls

The internal value loop remains:

```text
ron-proto economic DTOs
→ ron-ledger durable economic truth
→ svc-wallet issue/transfer/burn/hold/capture/release/receipt
→ svc-storage/svc-gateway/omnigate paid enforcement
→ ron-accounting snapshots
→ svc-rewarder payout planning
→ svc-wallet approved mutation path
→ ron-ledger receipt and balance truth
→ CrabLink display/user intent only
```

Phase 5 anchor-only material sits outside this loop as evidence.

It does not mutate the loop.

Correct Phase 5 position:

```text
internal checkpoint/root material
→ compact anchor commitment
→ optional evidence/timestamp/commitment proof
→ display/verifier metadata only
```

Not:

```text
external anchor
→ ROC mutation
```

---

## 26. Receipt status honesty rules for Phase 5

Receipt/status labels must remain honest.

Status meanings:

```text
accepted:
  svc-wallet/ron-ledger accepted the mutation.
  sufficient for normal paid unlock.

epoch_included:
  receipt is included in an epoch receipt root.

finalized:
  challenge/finality conditions are met internally.

anchored:
  optional external anchor proves that a compact commitment existed externally.
```

Rules:

```text
accepted must not be called finalized.
epoch_included must not be called anchored.
anchored must not be called balance truth.
anchored must not replace internal finality.
anchored must not mutate ROC balances.
anchored must not unlock paid content by itself.
anchored must not imply bridge settlement.
```

CrabLink display rule:

```text
Always label source and status honestly.
```

Backend rule:

```text
Only wallet/ledger receipts are economic truth.
```

## 27. Data availability and pruning doctrine

Phase 5 Round 2 will focus on DA/archive/challenge fallback, but Round 1 must not accidentally imply pruning.

Rules:

```text
No pruning before DA/challenge/archive fallback is proven.
No pruning merely because an anchor exists.
No pruning merely because a checkpoint root exists.
No pruning merely because a carrier assignment exists.
No pruning until missing-data challenges work.
No pruning until archive fallback is tested.
No pruning until restore-from-proof is tested.
```

Before DA is proven:

```text
prefer boring retention
reduce raw event scope
aggregate earlier
sample analytics
shorten non-economic telemetry retention
pause reward experiments if necessary
```

Do not solve storage pressure by pretending DA exists.

Economic receipts remain higher priority than raw engagement telemetry.

# What the CrabLink boundary check should enforce

The client-side check should scan React/TS/Tauri source for forbidden Phase 5 authority creep.

It should allow phrases like:

```text
anchor dry-run
anchor evidence
anchor status
checkpoint commitment
display-only
backend-derived
read-only metadata
b3 reference
```

It should forbid authority-shaped patterns like:

```text
anchorAuthority
anchorTruth
anchorSettlementTruth
anchorFinalityTruth
anchorPaymentTruth
anchorPaidUnlockAuthority
externalChainRocTruth
solanaRuntime
roxRuntime
bridgeSettlement
settleFromAnchor
finalizeFromAnchor
unlockFromAnchor
paidUnlockFromAnchor
walletMutationFromAnchor
ledgerMutationFromAnchor
balanceFromAnchor
receiptFromAnchor
```

It should also guard against unsafe Tauri commands or adapter APIs such as:

```text
invoke("anchor_*")
invoke("bridge_*")
invoke("solana_*")
invoke("rox_*")
invoke("settle_*")
invoke("finalize_*")
invoke("wallet_mutate_from_anchor")
invoke("ledger_mutate_from_anchor")
```

And it should preserve existing Tauri bridge doctrine:

```text
React calls TS adapters, not raw invoke.
Commands are small, typed, allowlisted, redacted, bounded, source-labeled, policy-aware, feature-gated, and testable.
No run/execute/eval/shell/native/raw_* commands.
No secrets, private keys, raw capabilities, spend authority, or backend truth in React state/localStorage/URL/logs.
```

---

# CrabLink paid/cache rules to preserve

CrabLink must not unlock paid content from anchor material.

Allowed paid unlock path remains:

```text
quote / prepare
→ explicit user confirmation
→ backend wallet path
→ backend receipt
→ unlock/render
→ display-only receipt cache
→ balance refresh
```

Forbidden:

```text
anchor evidence unlocks paid content
cache-only unlocks paid content
index pointer unlocks paid content
policy allow unlocks paid content
gateway header unlocks paid content
omnigate hydration unlocks paid content
client-side anchor status unlocks paid content
```

---

# CrabLink offline/cache rules to preserve

Offline cache may verify b3 before trusted render, but:

```text
verified cache cannot unlock paid content alone
anchor evidence cannot upgrade cache into entitlement truth
anchor evidence cannot replace backend receipt truth
anchor evidence cannot create balance/receipt/finality/settlement status
```

## 6. Non-negotiable Round 2 doctrine

Round 2 is **not** external settlement. It is **not** the bridge round. It is **not** the ROX/Solana round.

Round 2 is about proving that checkpoint/proof artifacts are not useless if raw data disappears.

Core rule from the review bundle:

```text
No pruning before DA/challenge/archive fallback is proven.
```

The review bundle is explicit: a checkpoint root alone does not prove data availability, and unsafe pruning before DA/challenge/archive fallback would make balances trust-me state. 

Carry these rules forward:

```text
No pruning in local-root mode.
No pruning in epoch-sealing mode.
No pruning merely because a checkpoint root exists.
No pruning merely because a carrier assignment exists.
No pruning until missing-data challenges work.
No pruning until archive fallback is tested.
No pruning until restore-from-proof is tested.
```

The review bundle also says economic receipts take priority over analytics retention, and high-volume raw events must be sampled, aggregated, capped, summarized, or classified as analytics-only before DA is proven.

This is not a live external chain integration. It is a boundary-hardening round proving that the future external posture cannot become authority over ROC, paid unlocks, wallet truth, ledger truth, receipts, balances, rewards, roots, finality, pruning, settlement, or market behavior.

## 2) Doctrine to preserve

QuickChain remains future settlement infrastructure.

The current runtime remains internal ROC only.

Core doctrine:

```text
determinism before distribution
DTOs before roots
roots before validators
proofs before pruning
internal ROC before external anchors
```

Active value-plane doctrine:

```text
ron-proto defines DTOs
ron-ledger is durable economic truth
svc-wallet is the mutation front-door
ron-accounting is snapshot/report infrastructure, not balance truth
svc-rewarder plans payouts only
svc-storage stores bytes by b3 only
svc-gateway is public boundary, not economic truth
omnigate hydrates/routes/mediates, not economic truth
CrabLink Tauri displays and requests user intent, not authority
```

Forbidden in this round:

```text
no roots
no root-producing code
no validators
no checkpoints as runtime authority
no live chain state
no external settlement
no public bridge
no ROX
no Solana runtime
no staking
no liquidity
no exchange-facing logic
no public market behavior
no public-chain authority
no paid unlock from external posture evidence
no balance truth from external posture evidence
no receipt truth from external posture evidence
no reward truth from external posture evidence
no pruning authority from external posture evidence
```

## 11) Things to remember for patch style

User preference:

```text
full paste-ready bash scripts
no Python helpers
low-disk workflow
focused tests first
then park scripts once
no duplicate exhaustive runs
no git commands unless explicitly asked
no workspace clippy
do not ask for confirmation if terminal output is enough to repair
```

Patch style:

```text
preserve RO headers
safe Rust only
test-only boundary hardening is preferred unless production DTOs already exist and need explicit hardening
avoid dependencies unless required
avoid production behavior changes unless necessary
use exact paths
include Cargo.toml only if dependencies change
```

Scanner style:

```text
Scan src files, not target.
Strip line comments before searching to avoid false positives.
Prefer specific forbidden authority strings over broad words that may already exist in legitimate docs/tests.
Do not weaken doctrine to pass scanners.
If existing source has legitimate terms like settlement in safe wallet handoff paths, narrow forbidden strings rather than banning the broad word settlement.
```

## 6. Phase 2 Round 1 goal

The goal is to prove paid flows replay deterministically and conserve ROC.

Core replay proof:

```text
same accepted operation history
→ same balances
→ same receipts
→ same holds
→ same terminal state
```

Core conservation proof:

```text
transfers conserve value
holds conserve value
captures conserve value
releases conserve value
burns/remainders go to explicit sinks
duplicate terminal hold operations are rejected
replay does not depend on DB iteration order
replay does not depend on wall-clock order
```

This is the trust layer that makes the Internal ROC beta credible.

Phase 1 proved that paid flow paths exist and preserve authority boundaries.

Phase 2 must prove that the economic truth produced by those paths is replayable and conserved.

---

## 8. Event class doctrine for Phase 3

Internal ROC Beta must preserve strict event classification.

Allowed event classes:

```text
economic_receipt
metering
proof_eligible
ad_budgeted
analytics_only
```

Rules:

```text
economic_receipt:
  backend wallet/ledger accepted economic truth only

metering:
  usage facts only; not payout truth

proof_eligible:
  candidate reward input requiring verification, caps, challenge, and policy

ad_budgeted:
  funded by explicit payer/sponsor/advertiser budget; not unlimited protocol emission

analytics_only:
  product analytics only; never protocol ROC payout material
```

Hard invariant:

```text
Raw engagement must not directly mint or allocate protocol ROC.
```

For ron-proto + ron-ledger, Phase 3 should make sure event-class DTOs and replay tests cannot smuggle:

```text
balance truth
receipt truth
payout truth
wallet mutation
ledger mutation
uncapped ROC issuance
raw engagement minting
reward-plan-as-receipt behavior
```

## 2. What Phase 3 proved

Phase 3 proved:

```text id="p0j747"
ron-proto DTOs keep reward plans and payout receipts distinct.
ron-ledger replays approved payout receipts deterministically.
reward plans alone cannot create ledger truth.
svc-wallet executes approved payouts only through wallet/ledger receipts.
svc-wallet duplicate payout idempotency prevents double issue.
ron-accounting observes payout receipts only after wallet/ledger truth.
ron-accounting snapshots remain derivative material only.
svc-rewarder emits deterministic capped wallet handoff candidates only.
svc-rewarder floor residuals are not silently issued.
svc-rewarder duplicate planning markers are dedupe markers, not execution truth.
ron-policy gates approved payout candidates declaratively.
ron-policy denials do not create refunds, receipts, balances, or wallet mutation.
```

Phase 3 preserved all major authority boundaries:

```text id="zr72gq"
svc-wallet remains mutation front-door.
ron-ledger remains durable economic truth.
ron-accounting remains derivative snapshot/report material.
svc-rewarder remains payout planner only.
ron-policy remains declarative gate only.
CrabLink remains display/user intent only.
```

## 10. Phase 4 coding rules

Carry these rules into the next patch:

```text id="ilnsgt"
Tauri primary.
React owns display/user intent only.
TypeScript adapters call Tauri/backend paths; do not use raw invoke from arbitrary UI.
No secrets in React state.
No secrets in localStorage/sessionStorage.
No secrets in URLs.
No secrets in logs.
No private keys, seeds, raw capabilities, or uncapped spend authority in client code.
Receipt cache is display-only.
Balance cache is display-only and must be stale-labeled if not freshly backend-derived.
Offline cache cannot unlock paid content.
```

CrabLink may:

```text id="dvbc8i"
display backend-derived receipts
display backend-derived balances
display backend-derived paid access status
show explicit quotes
ask for explicit confirmation
show stale/offline labels
show redacted/source-labeled errors
request paid action through typed adapters
refresh balance after paid action
```

CrabLink must not:

```text id="9ml8t6"
invent receipts
invent balances
invent finality
invent paid unlock
compute balance as truth locally
treat recent receipt cache as entitlement
unlock from offline cache alone
mutate wallet
mutate ledger
run reward payout execution
run bridge mint/burn
run staking
run liquidity/exchange-facing logic
```

## Phase 5 mission

Phase 5 has two big goals:

```text
1. Make configs/roc-economics.toml the canonical mutable economics source of truth.
2. Prove raw engagement cannot directly mint or allocate protocol ROC.
```

The Internal ROC model doctrine says mutable tokenomics values belong in `configs/roc-economics.toml` or versioned overrides, not scattered hard-coded constants. It also requires integer-safe values: integer minor-unit money, basis-point splits, no floats, no implicit rounding, and explicit remainder sinks. 

---

## Phase 5 Round 1 — TOML schema and validation

### Purpose

Create or harden the canonical economics config schema.

### Primary crate-pair order

```text
1. ron-proto + ron-ledger
2. svc-rewarder + ron-policy
3. svc-wallet + ron-accounting
```

Start next session with:

```text
ron-proto + ron-ledger
```

### First files/bundles needed next session

From RustyOnions repo root:

```bash
bash scripts/make_crate_codex.sh --force -c ron-proto
bash scripts/make_crate_codex.sh --force -c ron-ledger
```

Also check whether the config already exists:

```bash
test -f configs/roc-economics.toml && echo "configs/roc-economics.toml exists" || echo "configs/roc-economics.toml missing"
```

If it exists, attach or paste it. If it does not exist, Phase 5 Round 1 likely creates it.

### Round 1 work scope

For `configs/roc-economics.toml`:

```text
Define canonical internal ROC economics config.
Include schema/version.
Include units and basis-point rules.
Include paid content split defaults.
Include reward pool/category caps.
Include anti-farming caps.
Include rounding mode.
Include explicit remainder sink.
Include bridge placeholders only if disabled/inert.
Include staking placeholders only if disabled/inert.
```

For `ron-proto + ron-ledger`:

```text
Audit money/split DTO support.
Add DTO shape only if required.
Keep money as integer minor-unit strings or integer minor units.
Reject floats.
Reject malformed minor-unit money.
Reject invalid split/basis-point values where DTO-owned.
Ensure config cannot create receipt truth.
Ensure config cannot create balance truth.
Ensure config cannot mutate ledger.
No bridge/staking/liquidity/ROX/Solana/external settlement DTO runtime.
```

For later Round 1 pairs:

```text
svc-rewarder + ron-policy:
  - ron-policy validates TOML shape.
  - reject unknown fields.
  - reject floats.
  - reject invalid basis-point totals.
  - require explicit remainder sink.
  - reject enabled bridge/staking config unless future decision gate authorizes it.
  - svc-rewarder consumes validated config for planning only.
  - no hard-coded payout constants.

svc-wallet + ron-accounting:
  - config cannot directly mutate wallet/ledger.
  - accounting can label config version only.
  - accounting is not balance truth.
```

## Phase 5 Round 2 — anti-farming and event-class gates

### Purpose

Prove raw engagement cannot directly mint or allocate protocol ROC.

### Primary crate-pair order

```text
1. ron-accounting + svc-rewarder
2. ron-policy + svc-rewarder
3. svc-ads only if ad-budgeted flow is active
```

Do not include `svc-ads` by default. Add it only if ad-budgeted flows are explicitly active.

### Round 2 work scope

For `ron-accounting`:

```text
Isolate analytics_only.
Isolate metering.
Mark proof_eligible only after rules.
Preserve economic_receipt separation.
Accounting snapshots remain non-authoritative.
Accounting never mutates ledger.
Accounting never creates balance truth.
```

For `svc-rewarder`:

```text
Consume only eligible/capped inputs.
Enforce category pool caps.
Enforce per-account/site/content/epoch caps.
Use deterministic reward point conversion.
Use deterministic rounding and configured remainder sink.
Plan payouts only.
Never mutate ledger.
Never create receipts.
```

For `ron-policy`:

```text
Gate reward plan eligibility.
Reject uncapped raw engagement.
Reject analytics_only reward material.
Reject metering direct payout.
Reject config that enables bridge/staking runtime.
```

For `svc-ads`, only if included:

```text
ad_budgeted events must have payer-authorized budget.
ad impressions/clicks do not mint protocol ROC.
Ad-budgeted flow remains separate from protocol emission.
```

### Suggested Round 2 tests from buildplan

```text
ron-accounting:
  internal_roc_beta_analytics_only_quarantine
  internal_roc_beta_metering_not_payout
  internal_roc_beta_proof_eligible_requires_verification

svc-rewarder:
  internal_roc_beta_antifarming_caps
  internal_roc_beta_reward_point_determinism
  internal_roc_beta_ad_budgeted_not_protocol_emission

ron-policy:
  internal_roc_beta_policy_rejects_raw_engagement_payout
```

### Round 2 exit gate

```text
Raw engagement cannot directly mint/allocate ROC.
analytics_only never becomes payout material.
metering never directly becomes payout.
proof_eligible requires verification/caps/policy.
ad_budgeted uses explicit budget.
Reward plans remain non-mutating.
Focused tests green.
Park/preflight green once.
```

```text
Internal ROC first.
No ROX active runtime.

No external settlement.

No APR/APY/yield language.

No new ledger mutation paths.

No omnigate direct ledger mutation.

No policy balance truth.
No rewarder ledger mutation.
No raw engagement directly minting protocol ROC.
No config value directly creating receipt truth.
No config value directly creating balance truth.
No cache-only paid unlock.
No fake receipts.
No fake balances.
No fake finality.
No silent spend.
```

The correct value path remains:

```text
event classification
→ ron-accounting snapshot/report
→ svc-rewarder capped payout planning
→ ron-policy validation/gating
→ svc-wallet approved mutation
→ ron-ledger durable economic truth
```

Only `svc-wallet` may request economic mutation.

Only `ron-ledger` records durable economic truth.

# Phase 6 acceptance themes

## Full paid-content flow

Phase 6 must prove:

```text
creator wallet exists
visitor wallet exists
paid content can be prepared/quoted
explicit confirmation is required
svc-wallet commits the spend/hold/capture/transfer path
ron-ledger records durable receipt/balance truth
backend derives unlock/access from wallet/ledger truth
CrabLink displays receipt/access only from backend-derived truth
balance refresh is backend-derived
cache does not unlock paid content alone
```

## Replay/conservation

Phase 6 must prove:

```text
ledger replay reconstructs accepted operations
balances are conserved
idempotency does not double issue/spend
receipts remain stable after replay
operation_id is durable ledger/wallet operation identity
idempotency_key is retry key only, not authority
```

## Accounting/rewarder/policy

Phase 6 must prove:

```text
accounting snapshots are derivative only
rewarder plans deterministic payouts only
rewarder does not mutate ledger
rewarder cannot bypass policy
policy gates declaratively only
approved payout execution goes through svc-wallet only
ledger remains receipt/balance truth
```

## CrabLink Tauri

Phase 6 must prove:

```text
React owns display and user intent only
Tauri Rust mediates native privilege
TS adapters call typed commands, not raw invoke
no secrets in React state/localStorage/URL/logs
no fake balances
no fake receipts
no fake finality
no silent spend
quote -> explicit confirmation -> backend wallet -> backend receipt -> backend unlock -> display-only receipt cache -> backend-derived balance refresh
offline/cache cannot unlock paid content alone
```

## Gateway/Omnigate/Storage/Index

Phase 6 must prove:

```text
svc-storage stores/serves bytes and paid artifacts without ledger authority
svc-gateway is public boundary/proxy and does not mutate ledger
omnigate hydrates/access-routes and does not mutate ledger
svc-index resolves pointers and does not become paid entitlement authority
paid enforcement requires backend-derived wallet/ledger receipt/access truth
```

# 6. Critical bug found and fixed during Phase 6

## Bug summary

During live quote tamper probing, we found a real hardening bug:

```text id="n7jkau"
Route:
omnigate /content/view/pay

Problem:
pay accepted a tampered quote_hash

Impact:
The payment still went to the correct creator through svc-wallet,
but quote_id / quote_hash were not being enforced as payment preconditions.

Severity:
medium-high hardening bug

Value-integrity impact:
limited, because amount/recipient/wallet still enforced

Phase 6 closeout impact:
must fix before closeout
```

## Why it mattered

The old behavior allowed this:

```text id="o2mbbt"
valid quote for creator
→ tamper quote_hash
→ pay still accepted
→ wallet transfer executed
```

Even though money did not go to an attacker, this meant quote hash was not a real binding precondition.

## Fix applied

Patched:

```text id="yayrry"
crates/omnigate/src/routes/v1/content_view.rs
crates/omnigate/tests/content_view.rs
```

The patch made `/content/view/pay` enforce:

```text id="7pyiw5"
quote_id must match the deterministic current quote
quote_hash must match the deterministic current quote
missing quote_id rejects
missing quote_hash rejects
tampered quote_id rejects before wallet call
tampered quote_hash rejects before wallet call
```

The quote response now also lists required pay fields:

```text id="pyhhlf"
asset_crab_url
payer_account
amount_minor
recipient_account
quote_id
quote_hash
```

## Regression tests added

New focused tests:

```text id="6b9fs4"
pay_rejects_tampered_quote_hash_without_wallet_call
pay_rejects_tampered_quote_id_without_wallet_call
```

Focused Omnigate tests passed:

```text id="5ezu3u"
cargo test -p omnigate --test content_view
5 passed

cargo test -p omnigate --test internal_roc_beta_paid_content_access_boundary
5 passed

cargo test -p omnigate --test internal_roc_beta_phase4_confirmation_failure_boundary
2 passed
```

## Live fix verification

After restarting the stack and minting a fresh image, the same live quote tamper probe passed:

```text id="zq4rl8"
tampered recipient rejected
tampered quote_hash rejected
tampered quote_id rejected
balances unchanged
```

This is one of the strongest Phase 6 results: we found a real edge-case bug, fixed it, added regression coverage, restarted the stack, and proved the fix live.

```text
CrabLink user intent
→ backend quote / prepare

→ svc-rewarder capped payout planning
→ ron-policy gating
→ approved payout execution only through svc-wallet
→ ron-ledger final receipt/balance truth
```

This proof does not authorize any external runtime.

## 2. Current Doctrine To Preserve

### 2.1 Economic Truth

Backend owns truth.

The authority chain remains:

```text
svc-wallet mutates
ron-ledger records durable economic truth
ron-accounting snapshots/reports only
svc-rewarder plans capped payouts only
ron-policy gates/validates only
svc-storage stores b3 bytes/artifacts only
svc-index stores pointers/lookups only
svc-gateway enforces/proxies public boundary only
omnigate hydrates/composes access views only
CrabLink displays, routes, collects intent, and confirms only
```

### 2.2 No New Mutation Paths

Allowed economic mutation path:

```text
user intent
→ prepare/quote
→ explicit confirmation
→ svc-wallet
→ ron-ledger
→ backend receipt/access
→ paid render
→ display-only cache
→ backend-derived balance refresh
```

Forbidden shortcuts:

```text
CrabLink direct ledger mutation
gateway direct ledger mutation
omnigate direct ledger mutation
svc-index direct ledger mutation
svc-storage direct ledger mutation
ron-policy direct ledger mutation
ron-accounting direct ledger mutation
svc-rewarder direct ledger mutation
client-paid entitlement authority
fake balances
fake receipts
fake finality
silent spend
cache-only paid unlock
```

### 2.3 Client Boundary

CrabLink Tauri is primary.

Chrome remains proof/gateway smoke surface unless explicitly asked for Chrome fixes.

Tauri rules:

```text
Tauri Rust mediates native privilege.
React owns display/user intent only.
TypeScript owns no secrets/backend truth.
React calls TS adapters, not raw invoke.
Tauri commands are small, typed, allowlisted, redacted, bounded, source-labeled, policy-aware, feature-gated, and testable.
```

Forbidden command/API names or shapes:

```text
run
execute
eval
shell
native
raw_*
wallet_mutate
ledger_mutate
force_unlock
fake_receipt
bridge
stake
liquidity
solana
rox
settlement
validator
checkpoint
root
```

### 2.4 Runtime Path

Normal product runtime path:

```text
CrabLink Tauri
→ svc-gateway
→ omnigate
→ RustyOnions services
```

Localhost is dev-only.

Mobile remains gateway-first.

Direct internal service URLs are diagnostics only, not normal product path.

### 2.5 ROC / Paid Access Rules

ROC is internal only.

Money uses integer minor-unit strings only.

No floats for money.

Paid flow:

```text
prepare / quote
→ explicit confirmation
→ backend wallet
→ backend receipt/access
→ unlock/render
→ display-only cache
→ backend balance refresh
```

Local caches are display-only and never entitlement truth.

### 2.6 Tokenomics Rules

Mutable economics values live in:

```text
configs/roc-economics.toml
```

or explicit versioned local/dev overrides.

Mutable values include:

```text
payouts
weights
splits
burns
pools
caps
multipliers
rounding
sinks
```

Forbidden:

```text
hard-coded payout constants
float money
raw engagement direct minting
raw engagement direct ROC allocation
reward plan as ledger truth
config value directly creating receipt
CrabLink directly creating payout
```

Raw engagement may only become:

```text
metering
analytics
proof-eligible evidence
```

and only after caps and policy gates.

### 2.7 Passport / Wallet / Vault Rules

Passports are identity/capability.

Wallets are economic authority.

Alt passports stay separate.

No public main linkage by default.

React never gets:

```text
private keys
seeds
raw capabilities
uncapped spend authority
wallet truth
ledger truth
```

## 7. First Stabilization Round Goals

The next patch should likely focus on one or more of these, after code inspection:

### 7.1 Paid Access Route Hardening

Review and harden:

```text
svc-gateway paid routes
svc-gateway product routes
omnigate content_view routes
omnigate paid routes
omnigate site_visit routes
CrabLink AssetContentViewAccess
CrabLink SiteVisitAccess
CrabLink wallet/receipt adapters
CrabLink balance chip / receipt panels
```

Expected behavior:

```text
paid access is denied without backend proof
protected content is not leaked on denial
receipt/access states are backend-derived
client cache cannot unlock paid content by itself
gateway and omnigate do not mutate ledger
errors are redacted and source-labeled
retry is idempotent
duplicate confirmation does not silently spend
```

### 7.2 Receipt Display Hardening

CrabLink should display only backend-derived receipts.

Display-only local receipt cache may exist, but must clearly be:

```text
display convenience
not entitlement truth
not balance truth
not finality proof
not spend authority
```

Receipt UI should distinguish:

```text
confirmed backend receipt
pending retry
stale cached receipt
failed payment
denied access
network unavailable
unknown backend state
```

### 7.3 Balance Refresh Hardening

Balance refresh should be backend-derived.

CrabLink should not invent or increment/decrement balances locally.

Allowed:

```text
show last-known backend balance with stale label
trigger backend refresh after confirmed operation
display unavailable/error state
```

Forbidden:

```text
optimistic balance mutation as truth
fake “confirmed” state
using receipt cache as balance source
using localStorage/sessionStorage as balance truth
```

### 7.4 Explicit Confirmation UX

All paid actions should require explicit confirmation before spend.

The confirmation should show:

```text
asset/site/content identity
amount as integer minor-unit display
payer account/passport context
recipient/creator target when available
operation or quote ID when available
what access will unlock
what failure/stale state means
```

No silent spend.

No hidden retry spend.

No auto-confirm on page load.

### 7.5 Idempotent Retry UX

Retries should preserve retry safety.

Need distinguish:

```text
idempotency_key = retry key, not authority
operation_id = backend durable ledger-op ID
```

Retry UX should not create duplicate spend without backend confirmation.

If backend returns already-completed operation, CrabLink should display backend receipt/access truth.

### 7.6 Stale / Failure Labels

Every local/cached state should be visibly labeled.

Need display categories like:

```text
backend-confirmed
backend-denied
pending
retrying
stale
offline
failed
unknown
```

No UI should present stale local state as confirmed backend truth.

### 7.7 Redacted Errors

Errors should be:

```text
structured
redacted
source-labeled
user-actionable where possible
not raw stack traces
not raw backend internals
not secrets/tokens/capabilities
not private keys/seeds
not URLs containing sensitive data
```

### 7.8 Smoke / Check Scripts

The next round should include a reproducible local check script, likely app-local or focused backend-local.

Candidate checks:

```text
CrabLink Tauri launch / render check
gateway-first route check
paid/cache boundary check
receipt display boundary check
balance refresh boundary check
confirmation/failure UX check
gateway/omnigate no-authority check
bridge docs-only boundary check
```

Avoid duplicate exhaustive reruns.

Prefer focused tests, then one park/preflight gate.

## 9. If Blockers Appear

### 9.1 Backend Receipt / Payment Type Blocker

If gateway/omnigate/CrabLink cannot stabilize cleanly because receipt DTOs or payment result types are inconsistent, switch to:

```text
ron-proto + ron-ledger + svc-wallet + ron-accounting
```

Goal:

```text
standardize backend receipt shape
standardize operation_id vs idempotency_key fields
standardize display-safe receipt DTO
standardize stale/failure status taxonomy
ensure accounting remains derivative only
ensure ledger remains receipt/balance truth
```

### 9.2 Tokenomics / Reward Gate Blocker

If paid flows are fine but reward/payout/tokenomics gating blocks product readiness, switch to:

```text
svc-rewarder + ron-policy + configs/roc-economics.toml
```

Goal:

```text
validate TOML config
enforce integer minor-unit strings
reject floats
reject unsafe bridge/staking enablement
reject raw engagement direct minting
ensure rewarder planning is capped and non-mutating
ensure policy is declarative/non-authority
```

### 9.3 Storage / Index Blocker

If paid routes leak content or names/pointers are causing incorrect access behavior, switch to:

```text
svc-storage + svc-index
```

Goal:

```text
ensure storage is bytes/artifacts only
ensure index is lookup/pointer only
ensure neither becomes payment/entitlement authority
ensure b3 remains canonical content truth
ensure named crab:// routes remain pointers only
```

## 16. Architecture Guardrails From Broader Docs

Preserve the 33-crate canon.

No new crates unless explicitly authorized.

Key global RustyOnions invariants:

```text
kernel stays tiny
capabilities only
no ambient authority
DTO hygiene in ron-proto
OAP max frame = 1 MiB
streaming chunk posture = 64 KiB
bounded decompression
bounded queues
no locks across .await
content truth is b3
amnesia honored where applicable
observability is required
crash-only/backpressure-first posture
```

Omnigate-specific guardrails:

```text
omnigate is a view hydrator / BFF
omnigate is stateless beyond counters/caches
omnigate does not own durable data
omnigate does not own business rules
omnigate does not own ledger truth
svc-gateway sits in front for public boundary / quotas / load shedding
```

CrabLink-specific guardrails:

```text
Tauri is primary
React is display/user intent
Tauri Rust is native trust boundary
gateway compatibility comes first
OAP is Rust-side only
b3 hashes are canonical
wallet/ledger truth is backend-owned
no fake balances
no fake receipts
no silent spend
no arbitrary code execution
```
